title: Bahia web top navigation and dashboard card polish
description: Refine the Bahia web shell by replacing the text logo with theme-aware brand assets, reducing top-level navigation density with a grouped menu, and making the dashboard summary cards navigable.
in_scope: Theme-aware wide logo assets in the app shell
Dashboard stat card links and deployment CTA label
Dashboard pending-approvals reactivity fix needed for verification
out_of_scope: Adding brand-new dashboard destinations beyond existing routes/sections
preconditions: Bahia web app loads with the standard app shell
Relay-backed dashboard read models are available in the browser mocks for e2e verification
postconditions: Users can reach key dashboard destinations from the summary cards
Top navigation is grouped behind a menu while keeping a small shortcut set visible on larger screens
happy_paths: User sees the appropriate light/dark wide logo in the top bar
User opens the grouped menu and reaches dashboard destinations from sectioned navigation
User activates dashboard cards to open services, environments, workers, pending approvals, spend, or drift review
failure_paths: If deployment intents arrive after initial render, the pending approvals card must still update reactively
edge_cases: Keyboard users can close the menu with Escape and have focus restored to the toggle
Screen readers use visible card content instead of generic aria-label overrides
non_functional_requirements: Navigation remains accessible on smaller screens
Verification includes unit, e2e, and production build evidence
dependencies: Relay-backed controlplane browser mocks in web/tests/e2e/helpers.js
